items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then Pearl Bailey had a show for a while. Louie was the conductor. So he put out all the charts. I worked on that as long as it lasted.

ctx.x: Then Pearl Bailey had a show for a while. Louie was the conductor. So he put out all the charts. I worked on that as long as it lasted. It‟s work. You apply your craft, you get paid, and you go away.
Not something that you directed your attention to as part of your more monumental achievements.
